tagline: Verdant Teak Sanctuaries, Satmaliya Deer Park & Tranquil Reservoir Waters

overview.short: Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary protects verdant teak forests, undulating Western Ghats foothills, and the rich biodiversity of Satmaliya and Dudhni.
overview.description: Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary encompasses protected forested terrain across the Western Ghats foothills. Famed for its lush moist deciduous canopies, Satmaliya Deer Park, and the scenic Madhuban reservoir waters, it is a tranquil haven for birdwatching, nature trails, and wildlife exploration.

topPlaces.name: Satmaliya Deer Park & Nature Reserve
topPlaces.description: A dedicated protected enclosure within the sanctuary harboring flourishing herds of spotted deer (chital), sambar, blackbucks, and nilgai with watchtowers overlooking the scenic Madhuban reservoir.

image.alt: Satmaliya Deer Park & Nature Reserve scenic view in Dadra and Nagar Haveli

topPlaces.name: Madhuban Dam & Dudhni Lake
topPlaces.description: A massive dam built across the Daman Ganga River creating a vast picturesque reservoir offering panoramic vistas of foothill forests, speedboating, and serene shoreline picnic spots.

topPlaces.name: Vanganga Lake Garden, Dadra
topPlaces.description: A beautifully manicured 7.5-hectare Japanese-style lake garden situated around a serene central lake with rustic wooden bridges, thatched huts, and lush jogging trails.

image.alt: Vanganga Lake Garden, Dadra scenic view in Dadra and Nagar Haveli

topPlaces.name: Tribal Cultural Museum, Silvassa
topPlaces.description: A distinguished cultural museum preserving the rich heritage and lifestyle of the indigenous Warli, Kokna, and Dhodia tribes, exhibiting traditional musical instruments, ornaments, Warli paintings, and hunting tools.

image.alt: Tribal Cultural Museum, Silvassa scenic view in Dadra and Nagar Haveli

items.note: Spot herds of chital, sambar, and endemic forest birds from the panoramic watchtowers.
Enjoy scenic reservoir vistas, watersports, and tranquil lakeside walks along the Daman Ganga basin.
Stroll around the tranquil Japanese-style water garden and rustic wooden bridges.
Discover traditional Warli paintings, lifestyle exhibits, and indigenous heritage of Dadra and Nagar Haveli.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The best time to visit Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary is Oct – Mar. Summers are 26–40°C and winters are 12–28°C.

faq.q: How do I reach Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The nearest airport is Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Nashik Road (86 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: 2 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: Stays in Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary start from ₹2,500 per night, with options across 5 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The top attractions are Satmaliya Deer Park & Nature Reserve, Madhuban Dam & Dudhni Lake, Vanganga Lake Garden, and Tribal Cultural Museum, Silvassa.
